download_method: Public Kaggle API HTTPS GET; Shopee Thailand version 1 and FPT version 1, raw bytes preserved and SHA-256 checked.

datasets.title: Shopee TH: Customer Journey & Operations Dataset (Synthetic)
datasets.selected_use: Aggregate source-day session starts, product/cart/checkout page visits and orders. Use previous 30 days to forecast unique order count next day.
caveats: 100% synthetic independent simulation. Not official Shopee records or Vietnamese customer data.
Page visits are not add-to-cart action logs.
Source timestamps contain no timezone; preserve their calendar dates. UTC in processed CSV is a storage label only.
Some late sessions extend into 2026-01-01. Exclude those page starts because the source has no full target day there.
Blank order links and marketing fields are expected on some sessions; do not drop sessions.
Do not use target-day browsing counts, future order links or thank-you pages as predictors for that day.
Metrics describe this generated sample, not actual Shopee performance.

datasets.title: Stock Prices & Volume VN30 Index Vietnam
datasets.granularity: One observation per trading date after removing 87 exact duplicates and 1 identical date/OHLCV record differing only in unused Value
datasets.selected_use: Forecast next recorded FPT closing price in VND from 30 historical log returns.
caveats: TradingDate uses day/month/year; do not parse month/day/year.
Time is empty and unused for daily observations.
2016-09-23 appears twice with identical OHLCV and slightly different unused Value. Collapse to one daily price observation; reject actual OHLCV conflicts.
Close is used as supplied. No Adj Close or adjustment methodology is provided; corporate-action effects are not corrected or inferred.
No weekend/holiday interpolation; large returns are retained.
Historical snapshot is not a live price feed.

modeling_recommendations: Split chronologically by target timestamp, for example 70 percent train / 15 percent validation / 15 percent test; never randomly split time windows.
Fit feature and target transformations on training observations only. Use validation for model choice and keep test targets untouched until final evaluation.
Inputs for each target must end before the target time. Validation/test windows may use earlier known observations, but no future values.
Daily behavior forecast: compare against previous day and same weekday 7 days earlier.
Report MAE/RMSE in original units, plots of actual versus predicted targets, train/validation loss, and temporal train/validation/test boundaries.
selection_rationale: Shopee Thailand synthetic customer journey replaces Retailrocket for next-day order forecasting; FPT remains the Vietnamese stock example.
